title: Aquatic
intro: Census phase: vanilla data, plus the Ehlnofey target band of each record. Scope: mudcrabs, slaughterfish and horkers, with the Creation Club creatures of their kind beside them (the Frenzied Mudcrabs, Snippy and the Dwarven Armored Mudcrab on *Mudcrab*, Fangtusk on *Horker*). bands-of-power.md names mudcrabs and slaughterfish as Weak.

families.holds: the three mudcrab sizes (1–3), Old Salty, the Mudcrab Guardian Spirit, the Solstheim Mudcrab, the CC Frenzied Mudcrabs (9–20), Snippy and the Dwarven Armored Mudcrab
the Horker (3), Lord Tusk (25), the Horker Youngling, the CC vampire horker Fangtusk
